[8:08AM]  #FunsoWilliamsAvenue
#EkoBridge
#TrafficUpdate

Dorman-long  bridge inward Ojuelegba is busy due to the morning rush.
Ojuelegba bridge inward Barracks is a better movement.

Stadium inward  Alaka is good on both lanes as well.

Alaka inward Costain is good.
Eko bridge all the way to Apongbon is a  steady movement due to morning vehicular influx .

Eko bridge descending to Costain and  Apapa road connecting Nigerian Breweries looks good.

Barracks on the main carriage way, Ojuelegba inward Dorman-long bridge is also looking good.
#FollowLASTMA
